depiction.primary_object: tilted square diamond outline containing a smaller filled diamond

readings.meaning: hazard or road priority sign alert

ambiguity: It is an abstract concentric diamond symbol (used in Android for NFC, in video editors for keyframes, or in Europe for priority roads) that most users will not recognize out of context, and at small sizes it looks like a generic warning diamond.

reasoning: This is a system status glyph (Android's concentric-diamond NFC icon or a video editor keyframe diamond with an exclamation mark for error/alert). Most people will not recognize the abstract concentric diamond outside of a phone status bar or timeline editor, and it is far too easily confused with a generic warning sign.
